text:
ryan_le: Heads up @people-ops, I noticed my March 15 paystub shows BOTH CA and NY state withholdings. I moved from NY to CA on 2026-01-20 and updated Rippling on 1/22. Shouldn't all post-Jan wages be CA?

sarah (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, Ryan. Can you confirm the exact address you saved and whether you completed a NY state nonresident/part-year form?\n
ryan_le: Address saved as 89 Market St, San Francisco. I filled state section and uploaded a CA DE-4 on 2026-01-22; no NY form submitted. Screenshot attached.

diego (Payroll): Quick check: the Feb 28 payroll was processed with NY tax code for some earnings because the payroll system saw a NY payroll location tied to your profile until 2026-02-10 due to an older employee record. Looks like partial period wages were split across states.

benefits (Benefits): Also note that state-specific benefits (SDI/CA) kick in based on payroll residency flags; let us know if you need retro coverage adjustments.

ryan_le: Ok. Will this complicate my W-2? I don't want multiple state filings if avoidable.

diego (Payroll): It can show multiple state boxes on the W-2 if wages were subject to more than one state's withholding. We can either: (1) do an off-cycle correction to reclassify the earlier earnings to CA if documentation supports it, or (2) leave as-is and provide guidance for multi-state filing. If you have docs proving CA residency from 1/20, option 1 is preferable.

sarah (People Ops): Ryan, please DM copies of any lease or utility bills for Jan-Feb and we'll initiate the off-cycle reclassification request. Payroll will coordinate with Tax for state filing cleanup.

payroll-bot: Payroll ticket created: PL-10134: interstate withholding reclass for user ryan_le. Expected action date: 2026-03-10.

ryan_le: DM sent with lease and bank address proof. Appreciate the help.

diego (Payroll): Received. We'll attempt the reclass on next payroll cycle; if successful, we'll post a supplemental YTD statement and mark the W-2 for review. If not possible, we'll provide detailed docs for your tax preparer.

sarah (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Ryan, ping me if you need an employer letter for your tax records. :thumbsup:
